parameter.name: claimStartup
parameter.description: true: claim the startup restoration; startupClaimed is true for the first claim in this process only.

service.description:
Starts the subscriptions of the device gateway. The first call in a process starts every active (fromDate, thruDate) DeviceRequest of type DrtSubscribe, DrtEvent, DrtStateChange or DrtCyclic whose runServiceName is a service of this component; a later call restarts only the subscriptions that ended without an unsubscribe (a lost connection). An unsubscribed request stays stopped until it is run again.
The service job start_DeviceGatewaySubscriptions calls it every minute: mr-moqui has no startup hook, so the first run after a start restores the subscriptions. Set the property device_gateway_restore_subscriptions to false on an instance that must not own the subscriptions (only one instance should).
